title: Dire griffon / plains dragon transformation
summary: A dire griffon changes into a plains dragon when reduced below 80% health.
overview: A dire griffon changes into a plains dragon when reduced below 80% health.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Prepare the group before crossing the griffon’s health threshold.
The griffon disappears and the dragon appears in its place. Switch targets and establish the dragon on the tank immediately.
If the dragon is already present, the script waits rather than summoning another copy.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
